browser_api_findings.audio_worklet: Available in current desktop Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari; HTTPS secure context required. This is API availability, not tested app or hardware compatibility.
browser_api_findings.output_selection: AudioContext.setSinkId supported by Chrome 110+ / Chromium Edge; MDN compatibility data currently lists no Firefox or Safari implementation. Use feature detection and otherwise the system output.
browser_api_findings.sample_rates: Request 96000 Hz context and record actual context.sampleRate plus input track getSettings. Mic constraints may be ignored when unsupported; Web Audio can resample. A 96000 Hz context does not prove hardware rate or 27 kHz acoustic response.
browser_api_findings.full_e14_gate: Require context sampleRate >= 96000 Hz; ordinary 44100/48000 Hz cannot represent the documented 27000 Hz tone.
browser_api_findings.processing_screen: Require actual track getSettings echoCancellation, noiseSuppression and autoGainControl all false for processing-screen pass. Missing settings produce diagnostic status. This does not verify every hidden audio transformation.
browser_api_findings.stereo: A channelCount request is insufficient: inspect actual settings and observed input channels. Separate hardware paths and channel mapping require physical checks.
browser_api_findings.timestamps: baseLatency/outputLatency/getOutputTimestamp are browser rendering diagnostics and do not establish acoustic onset, neural-clock alignment or physical timing accuracy.
browser_api_findings.capture_security: getUserMedia requires user permission and a secure context, such as production HTTPS or trustworthy localhost. No automatic microphone start on page load.

timing_estimands.source_to_microphone: Generated output and captured input are compared on a common AudioWorklet process-frame grid. Includes browser buffering/resampling and full converter/speaker/air/mic path; excludes a measurement of Play-button latency.
timing_estimands.electrical_reference: Mic-minus-simultaneous-electrical-return comparison reduces shared output buffering. Browser channel mixing/resampling, input/output channel skew and physical routes remain unqualified.
timing_estimands.integrity: Frame/chunk continuity and channel counts screen observable browser-level failures only. They do not certify absent hardware xruns, clock drift, hidden processing or measurement accuracy.

scientific_boundaries: E14 is a reconstruction of the documented specification, not an original SONIC waveform file.
Browser seeded shuffle, equal-count balancing, ramps and digital level are declared local choices; browser and native shuffle orders may differ.
Delay checking does not calibrate absolute SPL, microphone sensitivity, frequency response, distortion or exposure.
Published paper sheep were awake/alert; planned Rice sedation remains an unverified adaptation.
Paper intrinsic 56/11 ms delays exclude physiology and computation; 11 ms is a narrower one-session window sweep.
No animal protocol, neural acquisition control, trigger synchronization or validated neural-clock correction is supplied.
No historical native-app delay estimate is reused as a browser hardware result.
